leadIn: After completing this lesson, you will be able to:
objectives: Initialize a component with asynchronous data dependencies
Configure TestBed to handle asynchronous operations in component tests
Implement fakeAsync and tick utilities to control timing in tests
Construct component tests that verify asynchronous data rendering
Apply async/await patterns to resolve promises in test scenarios
Manipulate component state to simulate asynchronous data loading
Integrate fixture.whenStable() to handle component readiness
